description: This source file provides extension methods for configuring and customizing the Orleans IClientBuilder. It includes methods for setting up connection retry filters, clustering options (localhost and static clustering), registering handlers, and other client configuration enhancements.

classes.name: ClientBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class containing extension methods for configuring Orleans IClientBuilder instances.

classes.name: DelegateConnectionRetryFilter
classes.description: Private sealed class implementing IClientConnectionRetryFilter that wraps a delegate function to determine connection retry logic.

methods.name: UseConnectionRetryFilter
methods.description: Adds a connection retry filter delegate to the client builder.

methods.name: UseConnectionRetryFilter
methods.description: Adds a predefined IClientConnectionRetryFilter instance to the client builder.

methods.name: UseConnectionRetryFilter
methods.description: Adds a retry filter by specifying its type, registered as a singleton.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Adds additional services to the client builder's service collection.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures client options via an options action.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Binds configuration data to options of type TOptions.

methods.name: AddGatewayCountChangedHandler
methods.description: Registers a GatewayCountChangedHandler instance or factory for event handling.

methods.name: AddClusterConnectionLostHandler
methods.description: Registers a ConnectionToClusterLostHandler instance or factory.

methods.name: AddActivityPropagation
methods.description: Enables propagation of Activity.Current through grain calls for distributed tracing.

methods.name: UseLocalhostClustering
methods.description: Configures client to connect to a local silo, with optional custom ports and IDs.

methods.name: UseStaticClustering
methods.description: Configures client to use static clustering with specified endpoints or options.
